'''FK Zeta''' is a professional [[association football|football]] club from [[Golubovci]], seat of the [[Zeta Municipality]] of [[Montenegro]]. It plays in the [[Montenegrin Third League]]. The club was the inaugural champion of the [[Montenegrin First League]] in [[2006–07 Montenegrin First League|2006–07]] season."}}
